name: Firmament
description: Five-point stars scattered over a night sky, gathering into bright clusters and thinning to pinpricks between them, each turned its own way.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--st); clip-path: @var(--st); transform: translate(@r(-14%, 14%), @r(-14%, 14%)) rotate(@r(-36deg, 36deg)) scale(@calc(max(0.24, @rn(0, 1.3, 1.3)))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 6%; height: 6%; left: @r(6%, 88%); top: @r(6%, 88%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.75; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --st: @shape(split: 10; r: 0.7 + 0.3 * cos(5t); rotate: -18); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
